target.statement: AutoConv achieves F1 of 50.48 on QuAC with 50 human dialogues (vs. 46.57 for finetuning baseline)
target.table_ref: Table 2, row 'AutoConv' under 'Data Augmentation (50 Human Dialogues)', column 'QuAC F1'

compute.basis: Paper reports 5 hours for LLM finetuning and 18 hours for generation on 8 Tesla V100 32GB GPUs; no code released, so agent must implement full pipeline including OPT-13B finetuning and synthetic dialogue generation.

blockers: Requires finetuning OPT-13B (13B parameters) which needs ~80GB VRAM for full finetuning
Generation of 40K synthetic dialogues takes 18 hours on 8 V100 GPUs
Training small task model on synthetic dialogues adds additional compute
title: AutoConv: Automatically Generating Information-seeking Conversations with Large Language Models
